name: color
label: Color
help: A hex color, for example `#1f6feb`. Leave it empty to keep the current color.

name: description
label: Description
help: Leave it empty to keep the current description, or map `erase` to remove it.

name: groupId
label: Label group
help: Leave it empty to keep the current group, or map `erase` to take the label out of its group.
